meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Ultra-compressed code review comments. Cuts noise from PR feedback while preserving the actionable signal. Each comment is one line: location, problem, fix. Use when user says "review this PR", "code review", "review the diff", "/review", or invokes /caveman-review. Auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把冗长的代码审查压缩成一行精准反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果受够了又长又水的代码审查意见
copy.tagline_en: Compress code review feedback into one-line actionable comments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of verbose and noisy code review comments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把代码审查评语压成一行一条，格式是「行号:问题。修复。」，删掉客套话；遇到安全漏洞、架构分歧或新手场景，会改回普通段落解释。
howto.when: 当你说「review this PR」「code review」或调用「/review」等指令时触发；审查 pull request 时也会自动触发。

say.text: 用 caveman-review 审一下这个 PR
say.note: Claude 会按一行一条的极简格式输出评语。

say.text: 帮我把这段 diff 做成极简审查
say.note: 只保留行号、问题和修复建议。
直接调用技能进行压缩评审。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude compresses code review comments into one line per finding: "L<line>: problem. fix." It strips filler. For security issues, architectural disagreements, or onboarding contexts, it falls back to normal paragraphs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "review this PR", "code review", or "/review" (etc.), or when reviewing pull requests automatically.

say_en.text: Make a terse review of this diff.

say_en.note: Invokes the skill for compressed review.
